verdict.rationale: Insomnia documents role-based access control (RBAC) for "fine-grain control over who can access which Insomnia resources." RBAC also appears as a listed feature on the pricing page, and organizations let teams share collections and environments securely, so the core of the story is covered. The evidence is only short marketing-level mentions, with no detail on specific roles or permission scopes. missing for 10: documented role definitions (e.g., viewer vs editor), per-API/per-collection permission granularity details, clarity on which plan tier includes RBAC, independent or hands-on corroboration.
